questions.q: Which Data Factory Studio hub is where you actually build pipelines, datasets, and data flows?
options: Learning center
Author
Monitor
Manage
questions.explain: Author (the pencil icon) is where hands-on building happens — Factory Resources on the left, an authoring canvas in the middle.

questions.q: What does the Factory Resources pane show?
options: A list of every Azure subscription you have access to
A tree of every pipeline, dataset, and data flow you've built
A list of every user with access to the factory
The billing history for your data factory
questions.explain: Factory Resources is the Author hub's navigation tree — select any item in it to open that pipeline, dataset, or data flow's editor.

questions.q: On a dataset's Connection tab, what does the linked service dropdown control versus the file path fields below it?
options: They control the exact same thing, redundantly
The linked service sets the file path; the fields below set the connection method
Neither setting affects what data the dataset actually points to
The linked service says how to connect; the path fields say which specific data inside that connection
questions.explain: This is the linked service / dataset relationship from Lesson 1 made concrete: the linked service is the connection, and the Connection tab's path fields specify exactly what inside that connection this dataset represents.

questions.q: What does the Monitor hub's Pipeline runs list show?
options: The DAX measures used across all reports
A list of every linked service configured in the factory
Only pipelines that are currently being authored, not yet run
Every pipeline run, triggered or debug, with its status and duration
questions.explain: Monitor shows every run — past or in progress — with columns for pipeline name, duration, what triggered it, and its status.

questions.q: How do you see a detailed breakdown of exactly how much data a Copy activity read and wrote?
options: This information is never available anywhere in Data Factory Studio
You have to open the Azure portal's billing page
Select the Details icon (magnifying glass) on that activity's run in the Monitor hub
It only appears in the Author hub, never in Monitor
questions.explain: Drilling into a pipeline run and selecting the Details icon on a specific activity run shows a full breakdown, including data read/written for a Copy activity.
